parent_objective: design measured intervention probe for the eligible t5_high_speed_close_obstacle subset
blocked_by: intervention continuations must be designed before any T5 candidate materialization
supersedes: candidate materialization directly from retargeted near-boundary traces

public_gates: M1516 must design bounded measured interventions for t5_high_speed_close_obstacle only
M1516 must define normal reset-hidden zero-response zero-action delayed and wrong-history handling scope
M1516 must preserve P0 actor contract and fixed checkpoint
M1516 must not materialize candidates or export training corpus
M1516 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during design
do not claim self-identification before measured intervention gaps

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded intervention continuations for the M1515-admitted T5 high-speed subset
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: intervention design only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if intervention design needs private holdout
stop if intervention variants cannot preserve P0 actor contract
stop if design depends on untracked env state mutation
stop if design would materialize candidates before measuring interventions
fallback_plan: if wrong-history is not implementable yet, start with reset/zero/delayed design and log wrong-history as follow-up
if env replay-to-decision is too brittle, route to runner state-capture design
if T5 subset is insufficient, route back to retarget repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1515 admitted a T5 high-speed subset to measured intervention design

admission_evidence: M1515 admitted t5_high_speed_close_obstacle retarget rows as suitable for first measured-intervention design
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up intervention implementation or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: intervention variants and implementation boundaries are explicit
eligible rows and excluded rows are explicit
next implementation or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1516 only designs interventions; later measured reset/zero effects are not enough for level3 self-ID without wrong-history or temporal evidence.
history_necessity_tests: design must prepare normal vs reset/zero/delayed/wrong-history margin comparisons
history necessity can only be considered after intervention margin gaps are measured
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1514/M1515 eligible T5 high-speed retarget traces only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If interventions do not produce margin gaps, record that as evidence about task/intervention strength instead of weakening the self-ID standard.
allowed_claims: M1516 designs bounded T5 measured interventions
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded measured-intervention design can test whether the eligible T5 high-speed retarget rows show outcome-relevant sensitivity to history and response ablations.
success_criteria: design names eligible rows and excluded rows
design defines intervention variants horizons metrics and artifact schema
design keeps candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export blocked
design routes to implementation or records a blocker
failure_criteria: intervention scope or eligible rows are ambiguous
design changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
design materializes candidates or starts training PPO promotion corpus export
decision_rule: M1516 passes if it designs bounded T5 measured interventions without materializing candidates, training, or claiming self-identification.
